name: Teknorulman A.Ş.
description: Precision bearings and drivetrain components for motorsport.
story: Teknorulman A.Ş. has been a leading manufacturer of bearings and drivetrain components in Turkey for over 40 years. With a commitment to quality and performance, they see motorsport as the ultimate proving ground for their products. They seek to partner with teams that demonstrate a similar dedication to excellence and innovation, hoping to showcase their technology on a global stage.
